newsitem.title: USA: Excel sees markets favorable for growth.
newsitem.headline: Excel sees markets favorable for growth.

text.p: Excel Industries Inc said Thursday the growth outlook in 1997 is favorable in most of its markets.
"Our automotive customers expect a year similar to 1996," said chief executive officer James Futterknecht in a statement.

"A combination of new product introductions, new program launches and generally good market conditions will benefit Excel's growth," he said, adding that inclusion of the Atwood automotive operations for a full year also will bolster 1997 results.

Excel, which supplies the automotive, heavy truck, recreational vehicle and bus industries with windows, seats and injection-molded parts, reported 1996 yearend earnings rose to $1.66 per diluted share from $1.41 a year ago. Sales advanced to $887.7 million from $596 million.
